+ // Question Processing Types
+ export interface PlaceholderConfig {
+   key: string;
+   value: string | number | undefined;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface QuestionProcessor {
+   /**
+    * Processes a question string by replacing placeholders with form data values
+    * @param questionText - The raw question text containing placeholders in {key} format
+    * @param formData - Object containing key-value pairs for placeholder replacement
+    * @returns Processed question string with placeholders replaced
+    */
+   processQuestion: (questionText: string, formData: Record<string, any>) => string;
+ }
+ 
+ export type GetProcessedQuestionFunction = () => string;
+ 
+ export interface QuestionProcessingContext {
+   currentConfig: OnboardingStep | null;
+   formData: Record<string, any>;
+   getProcessedQuestion: GetProcessedQuestionFunction;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface PlaceholderMatch {
+   placeholder: string;
+   key: string;
+   replacement: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface QuestionProcessingOptions {
+   /**
+    * Whether to escape special regex characters in placeholders
+    * @default true
+    */
+   escapeRegex?: boolean;
+   /**
+    * Fallback value when a placeholder key is not found in formData
+    * @default ""
+    */
+   fallbackValue?: string;
+   /**
+    * Whether to preserve placeholders that don't have matching keys
+    * @default false
+    */
+   preserveUnmatched?: boolean;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Utility type for extracting placeholder keys from a question string
+  * Example: ExtractPlaceholders<"Hello {name}, welcome to {company}!"> = "name" | "company"
+  */
+ export type ExtractPlaceholders<T extends string> = 
+   T extends `${string}{${infer Key}}${infer Rest}`
+     ? Key | ExtractPlaceholders<Rest>
+     : never;
+ 
+ /**
+  * Type-safe question processing that ensures all placeholders have corresponding form data
+  */
+ export interface TypedQuestionProcessor<TFormData extends Record<string, any>> {
+   processQuestion: <TQuestion extends string>(
+     questionText: TQuestion,
+     formData: TFormData
+   ) => string;
+ }

+ # Question Processing Type Definitions
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ This document describes the type definitions for the question processing functionality in the multi-step form component. The question processing system allows for dynamic placeholder replacement in form questions based on user input data.
+ 
+ ## Core Types
+ 
+ ### `GetProcessedQuestionFunction`
+ ```typescript
+ export type GetProcessedQuestionFunction = () => string;
+ ```
+ A function type that returns a processed question string with placeholders replaced by form data values.
+ 
+ ### `QuestionProcessingContext`
+ ```typescript
+ export interface QuestionProcessingContext {
+   currentConfig: OnboardingStep | null;
+   formData: Record<string, any>;
+   getProcessedQuestion: GetProcessedQuestionFunction;
+ }
+ ```
+ Context interface that encapsulates all the data needed for question processing.
+ 
+ ### `PlaceholderConfig`
+ ```typescript
+ export interface PlaceholderConfig {
+   key: string;
+   value: string | number | undefined;
+ }
+ ```
+ Configuration for individual placeholder key-value pairs.
+ 
+ ### `QuestionProcessor`
+ ```typescript
+ export interface QuestionProcessor {
+   processQuestion: (questionText: string, formData: Record<string, any>) => string;
+ }
+ ```
+ Interface for question processing services that can replace placeholders in question text.
+ 
+ ## Advanced Types
+ 
+ ### `PlaceholderMatch`
+ ```typescript
+ export interface PlaceholderMatch {
+   placeholder: string;
+   key: string;
+   replacement: string;
+ }
+ ```
+ Represents a matched placeholder and its replacement value.
+ 
+ ### `QuestionProcessingOptions`
+ ```typescript
+ export interface QuestionProcessingOptions {
+   escapeRegex?: boolean;
+   fallbackValue?: string;
+   preserveUnmatched?: boolean;
+ }
+ ```
+ Configuration options for question processing behavior:
+ - `escapeRegex`: Whether to escape special regex characters (default: true)
+ - `fallbackValue`: Default value when placeholder key not found (default: "")
+ - `preserveUnmatched`: Keep placeholders that don't have matching keys (default: false)
+ 
+ ## Utility Types
+ 
+ ### `ExtractPlaceholders<T>`
+ ```typescript
+ export type ExtractPlaceholders<T extends string> = 
+   T extends `${string}{${infer Key}}${infer Rest}`
+     ? Key | ExtractPlaceholders<Rest>
+     : never;
+ ```
+ Template literal type that extracts placeholder keys from a question string at compile time.
+ 
+ **Example:**
+ ```typescript
+ type Keys = ExtractPlaceholders<"Hello {name}, welcome to {company}!">; 
+ // Result: "name" | "company"
+ ```
+ 
+ ### `TypedQuestionProcessor<TFormData>`
+ ```typescript
+ export interface TypedQuestionProcessor<TFormData extends Record<string, any>> {
+   processQuestion: <TQuestion extends string>(
+     questionText: TQuestion,
+     formData: TFormData
+   ) => string;
+ }
+ ```
+ Type-safe version of QuestionProcessor that ensures form data compatibility.
+ 
+ ## Usage Examples
+ 
+ ### Basic Question Processing
+ ```typescript
+ const getProcessedQuestion = useCallback((): string => {
+   if (!currentConfig) return "";
+   let questionText = currentConfig.question;
+   Object.keys(formData).forEach((key) => {
+     const placeholder = `{${key}}`;
+     if (questionText.includes(placeholder)) {
+       questionText = questionText.replace(
+         new RegExp(placeholder.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&"), "g"),
+         formData[key] || "",
+       );
+     }
+   });
+   return questionText;
+ }, [currentConfig, formData]) satisfies GetProcessedQuestionFunction;
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Type-Safe Implementation
+ ```typescript
+ const questionProcessor: QuestionProcessor = {
+   processQuestion: (questionText: string, formData: Record<string, any>) => {
+     let processedText = questionText;
+     Object.entries(formData).forEach(([key, value]) => {
+       const placeholder = `{${key}}`;
+       const regex = new RegExp(
+         placeholder.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&"), 
+         "g"
+       );
+       processedText = processedText.replace(regex, String(value || ""));
+     });
+     return processedText;
+   }
+ };
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Advanced Usage with Options
+ ```typescript
+ function processQuestionWithOptions(
+   questionText: string,
+   formData: Record<string, any>,
+   options: QuestionProcessingOptions = {}
+ ): string {
+   const {
+     escapeRegex = true,
+     fallbackValue = "",
+     preserveUnmatched = false
+   } = options;
+ 
+   let processedText = questionText;
+   const placeholderRegex = /\{([^}]+)\}/g;
+   
+   processedText = processedText.replace(placeholderRegex, (match, key) => {
+     if (key in formData) {
+       return String(formData[key] || fallbackValue);
+     }
+     return preserveUnmatched ? match : fallbackValue;
+   });
+ 
+   return processedText;
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Integration Points
+ 
+ The question processing types integrate with:
+ - `OnboardingStep` interface for question text
+ - `FormFlowState` for current form data
+ - `MultiStepForm` component for dynamic question display
+ - Stream hooks for real-time data processing
+ 
+ ## Key Modules
+ 
+ 1. **Type Definitions**: `types.ts` - Core type definitions
+ 2. **Implementation**: `multi-step-form.tsx` - Main processing logic
+ 3. **Utilities**: Question processing helper functions
+ 4. **Validation**: Type checking and runtime validation
+ 
+ ## Extensibility
+ 
+ The type system supports:
+ - Custom placeholder formats through regex configuration
+ - Type-safe form data validation
+ - Compile-time placeholder extraction
+ - Runtime error handling and fallbacks
+ - Integration with streaming data sources
+ 
+ ## Performance Considerations
+ 
+ - Use `useMemo` for expensive placeholder processing
+ - Cache processed questions when form data hasn't changed
+ - Optimize regex patterns for better performance
+ - Consider debouncing for real-time question updates
